services.name: Scuba Diving
services.desc: The turquoise water, the colorful and stunning reefs, and over 400 species of fish are just a few of the things that enchant and amaze divers and snorkelers to explore the Belize Barrier Reef which is the largest reef in the Western Hemisphere. Belize is also home to 3 spectacular atolls: Lighthouse Reef (home to the great Blue Hole), Turneffe Islands, and Glover’s Reef. Atolls are in essence, a group of islands and coral reefs that encircle a central lagoon with a total surface area equal to that of the entire barrier reef itself. These three atolls are also outstanding destinations for scuba diving and snorkeling because of excellent visibility, best walls, and potpourri of marine life. J
